_doc: EXAMPLE project-routing + deploy config (single-host multi-project + git refresh).
Copy to .local/projects.json (gitignored) and fill in real values, OR let
port:           bridge listen port on the index host (unique across projects),
— GENERATED by add-project as source-truth/feishu-<projectId>; do NOT hand-edit,
model:          optional Bedrock model id (omit = global default),
repos: [ { subdir, source?(git|local), git(git source only), ref?, refreshIntervalSec? }, ... ] }
Top-level refreshIntervalSec is the global default (seconds); per-repo overrides it.
Per-repo source: 'git' (default) is cloned + auto-pulled on the refresh timer (always-latest
main); 'local' is a SNAPSHOT pushed manually via scripts/push-local-repo.sh (no git remote, no
auto-refresh — re-push to update). A single read-only git credential lives at
source-truth/git-credentials (R-cred-1), used only by git-source repos. Ports are declared here;
runtime ARNs / IPs are deploy products in .local/deploy-config, never stored here.
WHICH project a gateway serves is bound by PROJECT_ID (one Feishu app = one project).
If PROJECT_ID is unset AND exactly one project is declared, that sole project is used.
The gateway validates this at startup (bot-gateway/src/project-routing.ts): a bad config
fails loud rather than mis-routing at request time.
